chapter: Quality Serenaders, Cotton Club and union recollections
title: Lee Larkins, friend of musicians
summary: Howard says Lee Larkins hosted musicians at his house, had no band himself and was well known.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well, the places down on Central Avenue where Lee -- Lee -- what's Lee's last name? (Inaudible). Lee -- it'll come to me after awhile. When you all are gone, it'll pop into my head like nothing. Anyhow, this fellow, his name was Lee, and he had a band, you know, and he got -- I don't say you know, because you don't know, but everybody played in that -- everybody tried to play for that band. Lee Larkins.
Lee Larkins.

I knocked myself out. Lee Larkins was the guy, and he had us all over to his house when -- you know, had something to eat and all like that, and drink, and I can't think of the name of his band, but it'll come to me after a while, because I was playing in that club. Let's rest a minute, will you?
Rest a minute? Okay.
(Recording interruption)
That's all right. See all this--
if you can stay that relaxed.
Yeah, it's okay.
Don't worry about the tape. See, all this, we can just pick out what's good.
Lee Larkins was --
You say he didn't play anything?
Put it up a little closer.
Can you just mention that, he didn't play? What kind of guy was that? He had a band, or he just was around musicians, or what?
He was around musicians, that's all. And he didn't have no band.
And he didn't play anything.
Didn't play anything.
(inaudible) It was a band at this place?
Yeah, and I was one of them. (Laughter)
Was he a club owner or something, Lee?
No.
He was just always around where there was music.
Where there was music. Where there was music.
And did the musicians like him a lot?
Yeah. Lee Larkins? Yeah.
He was a good man, then.

Everybody from Steubenville, Ohio, they would say, 'There's Lee Larkins.' You know, he was given quite a hand (inaudible) -- and he played real good. And you know somebody I saw playing in a band, and I was just a little kid?
